title: Ling Yuan's Declaration of War
next_chapter_hook: On the day of the court assembly, Ling Yuan publicly accused Chen Ji of being a traitor to the nation, shocking the entire court. Chen Ji's false death identity was about to be completely exposed before everyone's eyes, and he had to make a choice—continue to endure in silence, or completely overturn the table?

text.content: Black light, like a venomous serpent's tongue flickering, wound its way from the letter, striking directly at Chen Ji's brow center. This was no ordinary spiritual energy fluctuation, but a will of perception beyond comprehension—as if Heaven itself was peering through the endless void, examining this insignificant piece on the board.

Every hair on Chen Ji's body stood on end. He instinctively wanted to dodge, but found his limbs immobilized by invisible shackles. That will carried no killing intent, yet brought him unprecedented suffocation—this was not a threat, but a 'gaze.' The Eye of Heavenly Dao was gazing upon him.

dialogue.content: "Steady your mind, do not resist." Mo Xiansheng's voice drifted from within the Tianji Record, weak yet carrying unprecedented gravity, "This is Heaven's mark... it has remembered you."

text.content: Chen Ji forcibly suppressed his surging qi, and asked in a deep voice: "What does it matter if it remembers me? If it wants to destroy me, it could simply descend with heavenly punishment—why bother to peer?" Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul fell silent for a moment before saying: "Because the Tianji Record does not permit it to act freely. And it... is confirming your identity."

"Confirming my identity?" Chen Ji's heart tightened. He had never imagined that his connection to the Eye of Heavenly Dao would arise from this letter from the Demon Sovereign. Mo Xiansheng's voice grew increasingly ethereal: "It is confirming whether you are worth its personal action... boy, the road ahead is more dangerous than you can imagine."

dialogue.content: Just then, hurried footsteps came from outside the door. Su Qingyao pushed open the door and entered, her expression grave: "Chen Ji, something serious has happened. Ling Yuan and Han Lie have formed an alliance, and the bounty notices have been posted across three provinces!"

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his thoughts and tucked the letter into his sleeve. Su Qingyao's breath was unsteady, clearly having rushed here at full speed. He noticed her expression—beneath the anger, a trace of barely perceptible worry was hidden.

dialogue.content: "The bounty notice states that anyone providing information related to 'Chen Ji' will be rewarded with ten thousand spirit stones. If they can verify the true identity—" Su Qingyao paused, her voice tightening, "one hundred thousand spirit stones, plus the position of guest elder at the Xuanwu Sect."

text.content: Upon hearing this, Chen Ji's lips actually curved slightly upward. One hundred thousand spirit stones, guest elder of the Xuanwu Sect—old fox Ling Yuan really spared no expense. He leisurely poured himself a cup of tea, as if what he had heard was not a life-or-death matter, but an insignificant piece of trivia.

dialogue.content: "Su Qingyao, you came all this way just to tell me this?" Chen Ji lifted the teacup, took a small sip, and said calmly. Su Qingyao's brow furrowed deeply: "You still have the mood to drink tea? The people Ling Yuan has placed in the imperial court have already started moving. Your pieces within the court... have all been uprooted."

text.content: Chen Ji's hand froze mid-motion. He set down the teacup, his gaze still calm, but Su Qingyao noticed his knuckles were slightly white. That was the trace of extreme emotion suppression—he was记仇 (storing up grievances). Su Qingyao sighed internally: This was the Chen Ji she knew—seemingly gentle, but one who remembered every grievance and repaid it tenfold.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji spoke slowly, his voice terrifyingly calm: "Uprooted... is that so. Ling Yuan has truly gone to great lengths." He raised his eyes to look at Su Qingyao, "What else?"

Su Qingyao's expression grew even more grim: "He also contacted the Imperial Censorate, saying he intended to impeach a court official for 'concealing their identity and harboring ulterior motives.' Although he didn't name anyone, but..." She took a deep breath, "The entire Tianqing Sect knows he's talking about you."

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan pressed step by step, and Chen Ji's chess game faced the risk of collapse. He had to make a choice—how to counter this meticulously planned encirclement?

choices.description: Since the identity cannot be hidden, why not proactively reveal oneself and publicly expose Ling Yuan's collusion with the demonic path at court, making him lift a rock only to drop it on his own feet.
choices.visible_cost: Expose Oneself and Draw Greater Threats
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan's reputation is ruined, and the enemy is defeated head-on
choices.risk_hint: Extremely high risk, may trigger chain reactions

text.content: A cold light flickered in Chen Ji's eyes. Ling Yuan wanted to use the court to pressure him? Then he'd show him what it meant to lift a rock only to drop it on his own feet. He stood up, his aura suddenly changing.

dialogue.content: He said coldly: "Since Ling Yuan wants to play a big game, I'll play it to the end. At tomorrow's court assembly, I will personally tear off his mask."

text.content: Su Qingyao wanted to speak but stopped, ultimately only letting out a sigh. She knew that at this moment, any dissuasion could not stop this man's determination.

choices.description: Temporarily endure. Use the Tianji Record to deduce every move Ling Yuan makes, precisely counter each strike before he acts, and render all his schemes utterly futile.
choices.visible_cost: Consuming Heavenly Fate Value, must endure the Tianji Record's backlash
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan steps deeper into the trap, unaware of his own doom
choices.risk_hint: The more the Tianji Record is used, the stronger the fate's backlash becomes

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, fingers gently stroking the Tianji Record Fragment hidden in his sleeve. Ling Yuan pressed closely, yet in doing so exposed his flaws. He would use stratagem to teach this old fox what it meant to have foresight without flaw.

dialogue.content: He whispered softly: 'Ling Yuan thinks I'm trapped in a dead end, not realizing he himself is the true piece in checkmate. Give me three days, and I will make him witness his own chess game crumble.'

text.content: Su Qingyao gazed at this man who seemed transformed, an inexplicable emotion rising in her heart. She suddenly realized she might never truly have understood him.

choices.description: Han Lie's pride would never allow him to be merely Ling Yuan's pawn. Exploit this vulnerability to sow discord within Xuanwu Sect, turning Han Lie into a weapon to devour Ling Yuan.
choices.visible_cost: Must reveal some trump cards to gain Han Lie's trust
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan's backyard catches fire, unable to defend both fronts
choices.risk_hint: If Han Lie sees through the ploy, the consequences would be catastrophic

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed softly. Su Qingyao stared in surprise, only to hear him say: 'Han Lie... Ling Yuan thinks he's secured a powerful ally, but truly has invited a deity of vengeance ready to turn against him.'

dialogue.content: He raised his eyes to Su Qingyao, cunning light dancing in his gaze: 'The Xuanwu Sect's premier genius, would he truly submit to being Ling Yuan's blade? I only need the slightest opportunity to turn them into sworn enemies.'

text.content: Su Qingyao felt a chill run through her. She suddenly understood: this man never made a single move without purpose. Every chess piece concealed seven or eight killing blows within.

As night fell, Chen Ji sat alone by the window, moonlight scattering like frost upon the ground. The Tianji Record Fragment drifted from his sleeve, hovering mid-air, golden characters dancing like living things. He closed his eyes, his consciousness sinking into that mystical prophetic power— it was time to see what Ling Yuan truly schemed.

dialogue.content: The aged voice of Mo Xiansheng echoed in his mind: 'Boy, Heavenly Fate is precious. Are you certain you wish to use it now?' Chen Ji offered no reply, simply pressing his hand against the Fragment. Agonizing pain shot through his brow center, yet he clenched his teeth and endured— he was determined to see Ling Yuan's hidden cards.

text.content: Brilliant golden light blazed! Chen Ji's vision blurred as his consciousness plunged into a chaotic vortex of time and space. When he opened his eyes again, the scene before him made his pupils constrict— it was a secret chamber, flickering candlelight, with Ling Yuan seated opposite a robed figure.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's voice reverberated through the illusion, dripping with nauseating smugness: 'That fool Han Lie, does he truly believe I need him? He's merely a discarded piece meant to draw attention. Once he and Chen Ji exhaust each other, this chess game will be mine alone.'

text.content: Chen Ji fixed his gaze on the black-robed figure. Though the face was indiscernible, that aura... unmistakably originating from the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path! He sneered internally: Well played, Ling Yuan, well played, righteous leader. So you've been secretly colluding with the Demonic Path all along!

The illusion continued to unfold. Chen Ji watched Ling Yuan hand a secret letter to the robed figure, bearing the unmistakable seal of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path. More critically, the words 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key' made him shudder— Chen Nian! Ling Yuan was coveting his sister as well!

dialogue.content: Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, cold sweat beading on his forehead. The Tianji Record's prophecy cut off, but it was enough. He murmured softly: 'Ling Yuan, oh Ling Yuan, are you not eager enough to meet your death?' A cold smile curled at his lips, killing intent blazing in his eyes.

text.content: He rose to his feet, tucking the Tianji Record into his chest. The burning sensation reminded him of the five points of Heavenly Fate consumed. Yet it was all worth it— he had obtained evidence sufficient to destroy Ling Yuan. The next question was how to turn this fire upon Ling Yuan's own head.

choice.prompt: The Tianji Record had revealed ironclad proof of Ling Yuan's collusion with the Demonic Path, and uncovered his covetous designs on Chen Nian. Chen Ji must now decide how to exploit this intelligence.

choices.description: Expose the contents of the secret letter and what he witnessed to the public, ruining Ling Yuan's reputation. However, this would also reveal the abilities of the Tianji Record and possibly attract further attention from the Heavenly Eye.
choices.visible_cost: Tianji Record abilities exposed, Heavenly Fate consumption intensifies
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan disgraced and condemned by the righteous path
choices.risk_hint: Possible direct intervention from the Heavenly Eye

text.content: Chen Ji took out a blank Jade Slip from his breast pocket and carved all the visions from the Tianji Record onto it. The evidence of Ling Yuan's collusion with the Demonic Path was enough to stir up a catastrophic storm.

dialogue.content: He tucked the Jade Slip into his sleeve and said coldly: "Ling Yuan, you want to judge me through the court? Then I'll let the entire world judge you."

text.content: Night wind rose outside the window, causing the candlelight to flicker. Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, his gaze deep and profound as an abyss. This game of chess had finally reached its endgame.

choices.description: Instead of exposing the evidence publicly, privately find Ling Yuan and use the evidence as leverage to exchange for his concessions and information about Chen Nian. This approach carries lower risk, but may breed a tiger for future trouble.
choices.visible_cost: May be viewed as weakness, emboldening Ling Yuan's arrogance
choices.visible_reward: Obtain clues about Chen Nian while preserving oneself
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may take desperate risks

text.content: Chen Ji fiddled with the Jade Slip in his hand, falling into deep thought. Direct exposure would be satisfying, but Ling Yuan was an old fox after all; hasty action might alarm the prey. Perhaps... first stabilize him.

dialogue.content: He murmured to himself: "Ling Yuan, since you can't stop thinking about Chen Nian, I'll use her as bait and see how much truth this old dog can spit out."

text.content: His eyes were cold and sinister as a snake, as if he had already set up a trap, just waiting for Ling Yuan to walk into the net.

choices.description: Forge evidence to make Ling Yuan believe the evidence has fallen into the hands of a third-party force, triggering him to panic and personally go to destroy the evidence, then catch him red-handed—killing two birds with one stone.
choices.visible_cost: Requires meticulous planning; any oversight could render all previous efforts futile
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan walks into the trap himself, leaving no room for redemption
choices.risk_hint: Complex to arrange, with numerous variables

text.content: A cunning gleam flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. He didn't need to actually expose the evidence, just make Ling Yuan believe the evidence was in someone else's possession. With Ling Yuan's paranoia, he would definitely personally strike to destroy the evidence—when that happened...

dialogue.content: He said with a cold laugh: "Ling Yuan ah Ling Yuan, your greatest flaw is being too suspicious. I only need to employ a small trick, and you'll send yourself right to my door."

text.content: He raised his brush and wrote several names on paper, each stroke seeming to carry a chilling killing intent. This game of chess, he was determined to win.

Meanwhile, at the Forbidden Grounds of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain. Ling Yuan stood alone at the Cliff Edge, the night wind stirring his gray beard and hair. Before him floated a pitch-black Jade Pendant, sealing within a wisp of Demonic Path energy identical to what Chen Ji had seen.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan whispered to the Void: "Holy Lord, that boy is more troublesome than anticipated. He seems to have sensed something..." A cold, sinister laughter came from within the Jade Pendant: "No matter. The Heavenly Eye already gazes upon him. He won't be able to jump around for long."

text.content: Ling Yuan frowned tightly: "But... Han Lie seems to have grown suspicious. He asked too many questions. I'm afraid..." The voice sneered coldly: "Just a discarded pawn. If he dares to ruin our grand plan, let him be buried alongside Chen Ji."

A complex light flickered in Ling Yuan's eyes. He slowly turned around, gazing down at the mist-shrouded Tianqing Sect beneath his feet. A surging tide of ambition rose in his heart. As long as he obtained the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, he could break through the shackles of the heavens and achieve true invincibility.

dialogue.content: He murmured: "Chen Ji... You think hiding behind that废物 skin can deceive this old man? This world has always been ruled by the strong!" With a wave of his sleeve, the boundless clouds churned like a tide.

text.content: Chen Ji stood before the window, suddenly feeling an inexplicable chill. He knew it was Ling Yuan's killing intent. The gaze of the Heavenly Eye had not yet faded, the scheming of his sworn enemy was drawing near, and the cards in his hand were diminishing one by one.

But there was no fear in his eyes, only cold calculation. Ling Yuan wanted to use the imperial court to judge him? Use a bounty to force him into the open? Let Han Lie be the blade? A cold smile curled at the corner of Chen Ji's lips—then come.

dialogue.content: He said in a low voice: "Ling Yuan, you press in step by step, yet you don't realize every move is within my calculations. You want to see my trump card? Fine, I'll show you—but after you see it, you'll find your own chess game has no way out."

text.content: He turned around, his gaze falling on that letter suffused with black light. The Demon Lord's surveillance continued, the Heavenly Eye's gaze remained, Ling Yuan's killing intent persisted. But none of this could stop his plan. This game, he must win—for himself, for Chen Nian, and for those he had regarded as pieces.

choice.prompt: On the eve of the decisive battle, Chen Ji needed to make final preparations. He had to choose a way to ensure his plan was foolproof.

choices.text: Seek an alliance with Su Qingyao
choices.description: Su Qingyao is Ling Yuan's weakness—she is the only one among Ling Yuan's direct descendants who doesn't know the truth. Gaining her trust can create internal chaos for Ling Yuan at a critical moment.
choices.visible_cost: Needs to disclose partial truth to her, possibly losing her trust
choices.visible_reward: Gain a powerful insider ally, can counterbalance Ling Yuan at crucial moments
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may not accept the truth and turn hostile

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then made an unexpected decision—he would seek out Su Qingyao. Not to use her, but to truly ally. He knew this decision might cost him all his disguises, but he had no choice.

dialogue.content: He said to Su Qingyao: "Senior Sister Su, there is something I must tell you. About Ling Yuan, about the Heavenly Eye, about... myself. After you hear it, you may hate me. But before that, I want you to trust me."

text.content: Under the moonlight, Su Qingyao watched him quietly. Her gaze was complex, but she didn't interrupt. Chen Ji took a deep breath and began to tell that long-buried truth.

choices.description: Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist can conceal the aura of the Tianji Record, and is key to countering the Heavenly Eye's surveillance. Securing her full support can seize the initiative in the court battle.
choices.visible_cost: Needs to disclose more intelligence to the Demonic Path faction
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Demonic Path Saintess's full assistance, shielding the Tianji Record's aura
choices.risk_hint: May deepen entanglement with the Demonic Path

text.content: Chen Ji took out a communication jade talisman and injected a wisp of spiritual energy into it. There was a secret method of contact between him and Ye Qing—one of the hidden pieces he had arranged long ago.

dialogue.content: He said softly: "Saintess Ye, I have obtained evidence of Ling Yuan's collusion with the Demonic Path, but I need your help. At the imperial court, I need your Demonic Path mist to conceal the Tianji Record's aura—the Heavenly Eye is watching me, I need a moment to breathe."

text.content: After a moment, Ye Qing's cold voice came from the jade talisman: "Fine. I will arrive before the court session begins. But remember, Chen Ji—the favor you owe me is far more than one life."

A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips: "Rest assured, any debt I owe, I always repay." He put away the jade talisman, his gaze sharp as a blade. Everything was ready, only waiting for the east wind—tomorrow's court session would be the moment of truth.

choices.description: Although Han Lie formed an alliance with Ling Yuan, his proud nature would never tolerate being a pawn. Approaching him directly and exposing Ling Yuan's true face might gain an unexpected powerful ally.
choices.visible_cost: Venturing alone, he risked being killed on the spot by Han Lie
choices.visible_reward: If he successfully persuades Han Lie, it would completely dismantle Ling Yuan's alliance
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie's fierce temperament makes communication extremely risky

text.content: Chen Ji made a reckless decision—he would meet Han Lie in person. That Xuanwu Sect's number one genius who had allied with Ling Yuan and placed a bounty on his life. He was betting on Han Lie's pride, betting that Ling Yuan's betrayal had yet to be discovered.

Deep in the night, at the Xuanwu Sect's residence in the imperial capital. Chen Ji moved between the eaves like a specter, finally stopping before a tightly shut door. He took a deep breath and knocked.

dialogue.content: The door swung open violently, a sharp killing intent rushing forth. Han Lie recognized his visitor, his pupils contracting sharply: "Chen Ji?! How dare you—" Before he could finish, Chen Ji raised a hand to stop him: "Brother Han, hear me out first. Do you know that Ling Yuan is using you as a discarded pawn?"

text.content: Han Lie froze. He stared at this "废物" who should have been hunted, a complex expression flickering in his eyes. Chen Ji knew he had won his gamble—Han Lie's curiosity had been piqued.

The next day, the imperial court assembly. Officials stood in solemn ranks, the Golden Hall solemn and dignified. Chen Ji blended into the crowd, his gaze sweeping across the hall like a hawk's. Ling Yuan, in luxurious robes, stood prominently at the head of the civil officials, a smug smile on his face.

Beside him, Han Lie wore dark armor, his expression cold and stern. But Chen Ji noticed Han Lie's gaze occasionally falling on Ling Yuan, carrying a barely perceptible scrutiny—the words from last night had clearly planted the seeds of suspicion in his heart.

dialogue.content: As the court session began, Ling Yuan stepped forward first, his voice ringing out: "Your Majesty, your minister has a memorial to present! Recently, someone within the court has colluded with the Demonic Path, plotting treason—this crime deserves execution!" His voice echoed through the great hall, making everyone's ears ring.

text.content: Chen Ji stood in the crowd, his expression unchanged. But his heart sank sharply—this strike from Ling Yuan aimed directly at the core. He knew that the "name" Ling Yuan was about to announce would be a vortex he could never escape.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan scanned his surroundings and declared loudly: "This person is—Chen Ji, the traitor of the Tianqing Sect, disguised as a Servant Disciple!" He sneered, "Your Majesty, this person appears worthless but harbors sinister intentions, secretly communicating with the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, intending to subvert our Great Yan kingdom!"

text.content: The court erupted in chaos. Everyone whispered and glanced, their gazes falling on Chen Ji in the crowd. At this moment, he stood at the eye of the storm, scrutiny and doubt from all directions cutting toward him like blades. Yet he remained calm, terrifyingly so.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slowly stepped out from the crowd, each step seeming to tread on everyone's heartstrings. He raised his eyes to face Ling Yuan directly, a mocking smile curling at his lips: "Elder Ling, do you have actual evidence for these accusations?"

text.content: Ling Yuan sneered: "Evidence? This old man certainly has evidence—" However, his words cut off abruptly. Because he noticed that Chen Ji's hand now held a Jade Slip, and the aura emanating from that slip... was precisely the mark of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path!

dialogue.content: Chen Ji raised the Jade Slip high, his voice echoing through the great hall: "Distinguished officials, the contents within this Jade Slip are the truth I deduced using the Tianji Record—irrefutable evidence of Ling Yuan's collusion with the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path! He accuses others of treason, never knowing he himself is the traitor eating from both sides!"

text.content: The court erupted again, more violently than before. Ling Yuan's face turned deathly pale. He never expected Chen Ji to possess something this lethal. In that moment, he finally realized—he was the one who had fallen into the trap.

Chen Ji watched Ling Yuan's dramatic change of expression, a cold smirk in his heart. Ling Yuan, oh Ling Yuan, did you think relentlessly pressing the attack would destroy me? Little do you know, I was waiting for precisely this moment—the more frenzied you become, the more flaws you reveal. And I need only gently push, and you'll fall into an abyss beyond redemption.

He stepped forward, his gaze sharp as a blade: "Elder Ling, dare you, before His Majesty and all the civil and military officials, explain the contents of this Jade Slip? Explain the matter of your secret meetings with the 'Holy Emissary' of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path?"

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's veins bulged on his forehead, his voice sharp: "Ridiculous nonsense! This Jade Slip must be forged by you—" Chen Ji interrupted him, his voice not loud yet clearly reaching everyone's ears: "Forged? Then this token given to you by the Holy Emissary surely cannot be fake, can it?"

text.content: With that, Chen Ji drew from his sleeve a jet-black token—precisely the communication artifact between Ling Yuan and the Demonic Path as prophesied by the Tianji Record. In the court, every gaze focused on that token, the air thick with suffocating tension.

dialogue.content: Han Lie finally spoke, his voice cold as freezing ice: "Elder Ling, the aura on this token is identical to the one you showed me before. Didn't you say it was a trophy seized from the Demonic Path?"

text.content: Ling Yuan's face contorted drastically. He looked at Han Lie, then at Chen Ji, finally realizing he had fallen into encirclement from both sides. He pointed at Chen Ji, his voice trembling: "You... you framed me!"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji had a sneer curling at the corner of his lips: "Elder Ling, framing? I merely exposed what you did before the world. This is called—using someone's own methods to deal with them."

text.content: In the grand hall, civil and military officials whispered amongst themselves. Ling Yuan trembled all over, unsure whether it was rage or fear. His gaze swept across the crowd, only to find not a single soul speaking for him—his carefully cultivated authority had crumbled to dust in this moment.

Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, gazing down at this former "sworn enemy." He showed no arrogance, no urge to kick a man when he's down—he simply waited in silence. He knew the true battle had just begun—the窥视 of the Heavenly Secrets still remained, the Demonic Path's conspiracy still lingered, and behind Ling Yuan lay even deeper secrets.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan suddenly threw his head back in wild, hysterical laughter: "Good! Good! Good! Chen Ji, you've won this round! But do you think this is the end?" Mania flashed in his eyes. "The Heavenly Fate mark on your body has long been探知 by the Holy Sect envoy—you won't survive this month!"

text.content: Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, merely saying calmly: "Then let them come try." His voice was tranquil, yet carried an unsettling chill that made one's heart race. Ling Yuan's laughter died abruptly as he suddenly realized—this young man before him was far more formidable than he had imagined.

In the grand hall, the situation was decided. Ling Yuan's crimes of treason and betrayal could not be defended against such ironclad evidence. Like an old wolf stripped of its claws and fangs, he collapsed to his knees in defeat. Chen Ji, however, stood quietly in place, savoring this long-awaited victory.

But just then—a jet-black lightning bolt descended from the sky, striking directly at the apex of the golden throne hall! Chen Ji's hairs stood on end as an overwhelming pressure, beyond mortal comprehension, crashed over him like a tidal wave. The Heavenly Secrets' Eye had finally made its move!

Chen Ji lifted his gaze toward that black thunderbolt tearing through the heavens, and an unprecedented sense of danger surged through him. Ling Yuan's downfall was merely the beginning; the true enemy—that existence transcending all will—had already locked its gaze upon him.

But he had no path of retreat. From the moment he obtained the Tianji Record, he was destined to play this game of chess against Heaven. Ling Yuan was merely a single piece on the board, and he... would ultimately overturn the entire chessboard.

dialogue.content: He murmured softly: "Come then, let me see what本事 the so-called Heavenly Secrets truly possess." Before the words even faded, a resolute gleam flashed in his eyes. Whatever hardships lay ahead, he would press forward undeterred—for standing behind him were those he had sworn to protect.
